title: Week 21 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “demand”?
options: An increase in a currency’s value relative to another currency.
Output produced per unit of input.
Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.
The quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a stated period.
questions.explanation: Demand means the quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a stated period.
choices: An increase in a currency’s value relative to another currency.
Output produced per unit of input.
Authority granted to local governments to manage local affairs.
The quantities consumers are willing and able to buy at different prices during a stated period.

The quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a stated period.
Negotiation between workers acting together and an employer over compensation and conditions.
questions.explanation: Supply means the quantities producers are willing and able to sell at different prices during a stated period.

options: A facially neutral practice producing unequal effects, which has different legal significance under different statutes.
A system combining markets with public regulation, provision, taxation, and social insurance.
A price and quantity at which quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.
Legislation authorizing government spending for specified purposes.

An organization seeking to influence public policy without primarily nominating candidates.
A cost or benefit imposed on a third party and not fully reflected in a transaction price.
GDP divided by population, often used as a rough average-output measure.
